about.title: About Suresh Hanje
about.subtitle: A passionate Kannada educator dedicated to preserving and teaching the beauty of Kannada language
about.bio_p1: Suresh Hanje is a dedicated Kannada language educator with over 15 years of teaching experience. Born and raised in Karnataka, he has a deep passion for the Kannada language and its rich literary tradition.
about.bio_p2: With a Master's degree in Kannada Literature, Suresh has helped hundreds of students achieve their language learning goals, from school-level academics to competitive exam preparation.
about.bio_p3: His teaching methodology combines traditional approaches with modern interactive techniques, making learning Kannada an enjoyable and effective experience for students of all ages.
about.philosophy_quote: Every student is unique, and so should be their learning journey.
about.philosophy_5: Connecting language learning with cultural understanding

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our Kannada classes
faq.a1: All classes are conducted online via Zoom or Google Meet. Each session is interactive with screen sharing, digital whiteboard, and real-time exercises.
faq.q2: Is the demo class really free?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely! The demo class is completely free with no obligation to continue. It's a 30-minute session where we assess your level.
faq.a3: Yes, we offer both basic and advanced spoken Kannada courses designed for people who want to learn conversational Kannada.
faq.a4: Absolutely! We have a special course designed specifically for non-Kannada speakers, starting from basics with English explanations.
faq.a5: Fees vary based on the course level and type. We offer competitive pricing with flexible payment options. Book a demo to discuss.
faq.q6: What is the duration of each class?
faq.a6: Each class is typically 45-60 minutes long. School students have 45-minute sessions while PUC and degree students have 60-minute sessions.
faq.a7: Yes, all necessary study materials including notes, worksheets, and practice papers are provided free of cost.
faq.q8: Do you offer both online and offline classes?
faq.a8: Currently, we primarily offer online classes. For students in Bangalore, offline sessions can be arranged upon request.
faq.a9: We offer both individual (1-on-1) and small group sessions (max 5 students).
faq.a10: Yes, all classes are recorded and shared with students. If you miss a class, you can watch the recording.
faq.q11: Do you help with exam preparation?
faq.a11: Yes, we offer dedicated exam preparation for SSLC, PUC, and competitive exams with model papers and mock tests.
faq.q12: Is there a certificate after course completion?
faq.a12: Yes, students receive a course completion certificate upon successfully finishing their program.
faq.q13: Is there an age limit for joining?
faq.a13: No, there's no age limit. We welcome learners of all ages, from young children to working professionals.
faq.a14: Yes, we offer classes on weekends as well. You can choose from morning, afternoon, or evening slots.
faq.q15: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a15: We accept payments via UPI, bank transfer, and digital wallets. Hourly billing and package options are available.
faq.q16: How do you track student progress?
faq.a16: We conduct regular assessments, provide progress reports, and have periodic parent-teacher meetings.
faq.q17: Do you provide updates to parents?
faq.a17: Yes, for school students, we provide regular updates to parents about attendance and performance.
faq.q18: Is homework given after each class?
faq.a18: Yes, light homework and practice exercises are given, designed to be completed in 15-20 minutes.
faq.a19: After the free demo, you can enroll for a trial month with a full refund guarantee.
faq.a20: We offer a full refund for the first month if you're not satisfied. After that, refunds are prorated.
faq.a21: Classes are available from 9 AM to 9 PM IST, Monday through Sunday.
faq.a22: A stable internet connection, a device with camera and microphone, and Zoom or Google Meet installed.
faq.a23: Yes, you can reschedule with 24 hours advance notice. Recordings are available for missed classes.
faq.a24: Yes, we offer discounts for group enrollments. Contact us for group pricing details.
faq.q25: What results have your students achieved?
faq.a25: Our students consistently achieve 90+ marks in exams. Many have topped in Kannada at their schools and colleges.
